title: Health and Care Worker visa: How much it costs - GOV.UK

content.p: When you apply for a Health and Care Worker visa, you’ll need to have enough money to:

content.li: support yourself when you arrive in the UK - you’ll usually need to have at least £1,270 available (unless you’re exempt)

content.p: You’ll be told how much you need to pay when you apply.
The standard application fee depends on whether you’ll be in the UK for:
The fee is the same whether you apply from inside or outside the UK.
You must have at least £1,270 in your bank account to show you can support yourself in the UK.
You will need to have had the money available for at least 28 days in a row. Day 28 must be within 31 days of applying for this visa.
You’ll usually need to show proof of this when you apply , unless either:

content.li: you’ve been in the UK with a valid visa for at least 12 months
your employer can cover your costs during your first month in the UK

content.p: Your partner and children will also need to prove they can support themselves while they’re in the UK. Check how much they’ll need .
Read the guidance on financial evidence for more information about the money you need and how to prove it.

content.h3: If your employer can support you instead

content.p: Your certificate of sponsorship must confirm this. Your employer will need to complete the ‘sponsor certifies maintenance’ section on your certificate. This is under ‘Additional data’.
